correctness.rationale: Correct on invariant Farey-triangle ensemble m=2 da db conditioned on roof 1/(ab)>R, R->infinity. E_R is precisely two thin corner wedges. With d=min(a,b), rescale z=Rd to find limiting corner-area density z and m(E_R)~2/R^2, giving V=Rd with cdf v^2. A first/second-index orientation reduction reaches (u,u-d), u=1+O(d), followed by exact index-two states (u-l d,u-(l+1)d) until floor((1+s)/s) crosses the strict branch boundary. Its ceiling gives tau_R=1/(2d)+O(1) uniformly; mapped by Rd -> V this yields H=1/(2V), P(H>t)=1 for t<1/2, 1/(4t^2) thereafter. For any compact J inside (0,1/2), orbit at floor(tR) differs uniformly from (1-tRd,1-tRd) by O(1/R); roof continuity yields the stated path. Independent exact-rational replay checked both cusp orientations, index-two branch and first-exit arithmetic on 12 cases, but not infinite convergence.
